Not yet: the change has only been tested with streamed chunks built in the unit tests (a tool call arriving in several deltas, and the final `finish_reason`), not against a live OpenAI endpoint, and there are no logs from one to add to the description. A live run needs an API key that I can't use here, so I'd rather not post unverified output. If it is blocking, I can add a short script that streams a tool call through `mlflow.openai.autolog()` and prints the recorded span, so someone with a key can run it and paste the result.
@pcbeingused333 Yes, I would want a fix to be tested against a live API endpoint to make sure it works.
